root_cause: The production media router required mira-continuous-human-video-v1 temporal proof but no canonical executor generated that proof.
Valid OpenArt Mira Reels could therefore pass all exact frame vision checks and still remain permanently blocked before publication.
prevention: The canonical router invokes powerhouse-instagram-temporal-verifier automatically for every Reel after exact video hash and start/middle/end frame extraction.
The temporal verifier evaluates the ordered exact frames together using the approved Anthropic visual-governance model and binds evidence to the exact video SHA-256.
Publication remains fail-closed unless identity continuity, scene continuity, human motion, natural camera motion and anti-slideshow/anti-still-animation checks all pass at confidence >= 0.90.
No caller-supplied temporal booleans are sufficient publication proof.

evidence.production_incident: instagram_company remained blocked after exact Mira frame proof because no canonical temporal-proof executor existed
evidence.production_validation: 2026-09-26 exact OpenArt MP4 passed start/middle/end Mira vision plus canonical temporal verifier at confidence 0.93
